Title: Public preview: Support for Windows clients using Azure Monitor agent

Body.Content:
The Azure Monitor agent and data collection rules now support Windows 10 and 11 client devices, via the new Windows MSI installer launched in public preview today. You can extend the use of the same agent for telemetry and security management (using Sentinel) across your service and device landscape. Visit our documentation to learn more.

Follow these steps to configure the new installer to collect data from your client devices and share your feedback with us to address your requirements better. 

Review the updated migration guidance to start migrating to the new agent.
